title: Day 773: Tepuche Municipal Syndic Kidnapped and Killed Alongside Brother — Second Official From Community Murdered in 2026
detail: Armed men abducted David Guadalupe Ramírez González, the síndico (municipal syndic) of Tepuche, from his home at approximately 5:00 AM on Friday, September 4, 2026. His brother, Manuel Enrique Ramírez, roughly 48, was shot and injured while trying to prevent the abduction and later died of his wounds. Around 4:20 PM the same day, authorities recovered David Guadalupe's body near farmland in the Tepuchito area, north of Culiacán. Ramírez González had held the síndico post for less than five months, having taken office on April 18, 2026 after his predecessor, Héctor Bartolo Zamudio Ríos, was assassinated on March 31, 2026 — making him the second consecutive Tepuche official killed in 2026. The Sinaloa State Attorney General's Office opened an investigation into both deaths; no arrests had been announced.

media.caption: Coverage of the kidnapping and killing of Tepuche síndico David Guadalupe Ramírez González and his brother Manuel Enrique, September 4, 2026
